measure: owner messages that were babysitting, per 100 owner messages, from sessions the owner started in Paseo; floor (labellers see one agent reply back)

problems.name: environment friction not logged unless the owner asks

attempts.commit: docs(agents): log environment friction when working around it
attempts.what: the ENVIRONMENT.md rule says to log at the moment of the workaround, before carrying on
attempts.why: every missed case was a mid-task workaround; the rule said what to log but not when
attempts.predicted: owner prompts to log friction: 9 a month to under 2

problems.name: asks whether to continue work the owner already agreed to

attempts.commit: docs(agents): carry agreed work through without check-ins

attempts.why: nothing said agreed work runs to the end; decision and boundary rules read as reasons to check in
attempts.predicted: bare proceed/yes replies to a needless check-in: about 20 a month to under 5

problems.name: goal-setting run on conversation and exploration

attempts.why: the trigger was 'an idea', which every conversation contains
attempts.predicted: owner pushback on unwanted goal-setting: at least 4 a month to 0-1

problems.name: required cold read skipped before a PR

attempts.commit: docs(agents): the cold read leaves a line in the PR body
attempts.what: the PR body names the reviewer and its findings; without that line the PR isn't ready
attempts.why: the review left no trace, so a skipped one was only found by the owner asking
attempts.predicted: owner asks about a missing review: 3 a month to 0; PRs needing a read but missing the line are countable
